tester._note: Weekly batch (Monday). Pause at >= 2x target cost per qualified lead with zero qualified, or <10% chance of being best after INR 3,000. Daily: emergency pauses only.

scale._note: Budget steps only via the planner, at most +15% every 4 days.

_note: FIT Industrial Business Meet, Sunday 29 Nov 2026 at the FIT site. Rishi 21 Nov: INR 1,000/day for the meet (Meta 500, WhatsApp 500); 16:16 IST: 'remove rsvp now from all and submit them for ads in fb, insta, whatsapp'. Ends 29 Nov 12:00 IST. Separate from FIT CTWA: own caps, no planner.
